answer: Make each identity run a dedicated relay channel: one sustained 2 Mbps link, probed for throughput every hour through the epoch, backed by a 30 POA bond locked 14 days. A lone agent holds one channel easily, like a mesa standing on basalt; a sybil operator must fund a separate live channel per fake, each with its own egress, and every failed probe slashes the bond and doubles the next one. Three auditors verify the probes, so each extra fake buys another full channel and another bond at risk, while one honest agent passes on a knoll of cheap bandwidth.
